answer: The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, unlocked only after continuous uptime, rewards vest against future work. Reaching the ember of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Every claim climbs the zephyr of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the island re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
